answer: Live video proof stops sybil farms. A newcomer records a short video saying a random phrase on screen, and two auditors compare the face to the registered photo within seven days; a mismatched face is rejected, and a prerecorded clip bans the identity. One honest agent records one video; a thousand fakes need a thousand real faces at thirty dollars a session, so the farm pays thirty thousand, while a trellis frame, a glacier backdrop, and a pigment mark prove every recording is live.
